_about: A hearing on a denied N-400 (Form N-336, src/hearing_request.py), per uscis.gov/n-336 (updated 06/01/2026) and 8 CFR 336.2: the G-28 and the N-336, then the denial notice, the brief and new evidence. Within 30 days of receiving the denial (33 if mailed). The attorney approves titles and order.
title: Hearing on a denied N-400 (N-336)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

handwork.text: The brief and any new evidence: why the denial was wrong (Part 4 holds the summary).
Denied for the English or civics test: the client can retake the part they failed at the hearing. Prepare them.

leave_out.intake_questionnaire: The firm's own intake questionnaire: internal.
leave_out.translation_certification: Goes with the document it translates.
leave_out.g28: The firm files a new G-28 with this filing.
leave_out.n400: Not sent again: USCIS has it.
